select from orient_task_alternative where task_id = #{taskId} order by alternative_task_type
mapper.insert: insert into orient_task_alternative (topic_id, task_id, alternative_task_type, prompt_text, answer_hash, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{topicId}, #{taskId}, #{alternativeTaskType}, #{promptText}, #{answerHash}, #{enabled}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

mapper.insert: insert into orient_task_attempt (member_id, activity_id, topic_id, play_instance_id, task_id, alternative_task_type, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, pic_url, report_coord_sys, wgs84_lng, wgs84_lat, distance_m, node_geo_dirty, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{activityId}, #{topicId}, #{playInstanceId}, #{taskId}, #{alternativeTaskType}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{picUrl}, #{reportCoordSys}, #{wgs84Lng}, #{wgs84Lat}, #{distanceM}, #{nodeGeoDirty}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert into orient_task_completion (member_id, activity_id, topic_id, play_instance_id, task_id, completed_via, source_attempt_id, completed_time) values (#{memberId}, #{activityId}, #{topicId}, #{playInstanceId}, #{taskId}, #{completedVia}, #{sourceAttemptId}, #{completedTime})
mapper.select: select t.id as team_id, t.title as title, t.max_members as max_members, t.joined_count as joined_count, t.status as status, t.expire_time as expire_time, t.leader_member_id as leader_member_id, u.nickname as leader_name, u.avatar as leader_avatar from play_team t left join ums_member u on u.id = t.leader_member_id where t.owner_type = #{ownerType} and t.owner_id = #{ownerId} and t.join_mode = 2 and t.status = 0 order by t.create_time desc, t.id desc limit #{limit}

select id, owner_type, owner_id, leader_member_id, title, join_mode, max_members, joined_count, status, expire_time, create_time from play_team where owner_type = #{ownerType} and owner_id = #{ownerId} and status in (0, 1, 2, 3) order by id asc limit #{limit}

select m.team_id as team_id, m.member_id as member_id, m.role as role, u.nickname as member_name, u.avatar as member_avatar from play_team_member m left join ums_member u on u.id = m.member_id where m.status = 1 and m.team_id in #{tid} order by m.team_id asc, m.role desc, m.create_time asc, m.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into orient_safety_rule (topic_id, insurance_required, night_start_minute, night_end_minute, weather_block, weather_reason, weather_block_until, update_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{topicId}, 0, #{nightStartMinute}, #{nightEndMinute}, #{weatherBlock}, #{weatherReason}, #{weatherBlockUntil}, #{updateBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
